name: schlaufuchs-design-system
description: The fox's design system: DTCG tokens and plain CSS in @schlaufuchs/tokens, typed React components in @schlaufuchs/react.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tokens build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun scripts/build-docs.ts
